description: Read-only: changes nothing in the model. Call it before ec_moving_loads to see what the Eurocode - Moving Load Wizard would do. Returns: existing (the lanes, vehicles, cases and groups already in the model, each marked if an earlier ec_moving_loads run created it); laneKindSuggestion (LINE for beams, SURFACE for plates); deckRead (reference girder or plate edge, width, kerb offset, cross-beam group, skew — narrowed by deckFilter, reversed by trafficOtherWay); the lanes, lane roles and cases the given settings would produce; config (the plugin's own settings file — pass it back as configFile); options (valid load groups, vehicles and Irish Rail trains). Takes the same inputs as ec_moving_loads; the write permissions (codeChange, unitSwitch) only change which blockers are listed.

codeChange.description: A permission for the write tool. Here it only changes which blockers are listed — this tool never writes. Accepted so the same inputs serve both tools.

config.description: Advanced: any other plugin configuration field, deep-merged over the settings.

configFile.description: The plugin's own Export JSON settings file (or its "config"), as text or object: starts from those settings instead of the defaults. The deck is then not re-read unless readDeck: true.

deckFilter.description: Read the deck only from these members, as the plugin's Show only: group (structure group name), section ("S:<id>" beam section or "T:<id>" plate thickness), zMin / zMax (level band, m).

irishRailTrains.description: Irish Rail CCE-STR-PSD-008 Appendix C trains on the tracks: true for all, or train ids / names (ec_moving_loads_read options). Dynamic factor settings in loading.ieRail.

laneKind.description: Default: what the model suggests (beams -> LINE, plates -> SURFACE).

laneSource.description: NEW shows the lanes the settings would lay out; EXISTING shows the lanes already in the model.

lanes.description: Lane options: prefix (default EC), packing, wheelSpace, optimiseNotional, lm2Manual / lm2Centre, sv / svCentre / svWidth (LM3 route), tracks { tracks, firstTrack, spacing, gauge }, userLanes.

loading.description: Loading (the plugin's Loading step): disciplines (ROAD, FATIGUE, RAIL), groups (gr1a, gr1b, gr3, gr4, gr5 — the road models follow), roadModels / excludedModels, fatigueModels, railModels, lm3Vehicles, psiValues (CHARACTERISTIC, FREQUENT), factors (alphaPreset EN|UK, alphaQ, alphaq…, footwayCombination), laneLoading, minLoadedLanes / maxLoadedLanes, straddle (MANUAL|ADJACENT), loadRemainingArea, userCases, ieRail…

readDeck.description: Read the reference line / alignment, width, kerb offset, cross beams and skew from the deck (default on, off over a loaded settings file).

reference.description: Line lanes: the reference line. mode RANGE (range: element ids e.g. '1-10'), GROUP (group), or NODES (nodes: [ids], shape).

section.description: Carriageway cross-section, m: width, kerbOffset, verges, footways, central reserve… width/kerbOffset are read from the deck if omitted.

surface.description: Surface lanes: the alignment. mode GROUP (group), NODES (nodes) or RANGE (range).

trafficOtherWay.description: Read the deck the other way round (the plugin's "Traffic runs the other way").

unitSwitch.description: A permission for the write tool. Here it only changes which blockers are listed — this tool never writes. Accepted so the same inputs serve both tools.

writeOptions.description: Lane write options the write tool would use (loadDist, groupName, moving, skewStart/skewEnd); here they only shape the lanes shown.

name: ec_moving_loads_read
title: Read the model for Eurocode moving loads
